storyCards.headline: Time Has Come Today: The Performance That Defined It
storyCards.fact:
The Chambers Brothers's "Time Has Come Today" reached #11 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #11 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

Time Has Come Today was released in 1968.

"Time Has Come Today" by The Chambers Brothers.

Chart story — peaked at #11 on the Hot 100.
